headword: {八十八箇所|はちじゅうはっかしょ}
reading: はちじゅうはっかしょ
gloss: the eighty-eight temples of Shikoku; the Shikoku pilgrimage

definitions.gloss: the eighty-eight temples of Shikoku; the pilgrimage circuit
definitions.explanation: The eighty-eight Buddhist temples on the island of Shikoku linked with Kōbō Daishi (Kūkai), and the pilgrimage of about 1,200 km that visits them in turn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧{八十八箇所|はちじゅうはっかしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧。
examples.english: To make the circuit of the eighty-eight temples of Shikoku.

examples.japanese: {八十八箇所|はちじゅうはっかしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一|ひと}か{月|げつ}⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ほど⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Walking the whole eighty-eight-temple circuit takes about a month and a half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白装束|しろしょうぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧{八十八箇所|はちじゅうはっかしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{遍路|へんろ}→お遍路：19059_ohenro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After retiring, my father put on white pilgrim's clothes and set out on the eighty-eight-temple pilgrimage.

notes:
The pilgrimage itself is called ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧⟦{遍路|へんろ}→遍路：31830_henro⟧ or ⟦お{遍路|へんろ}→お遍路：19059_ohenro⟧, and the pilgrims ⟦お{遍路|へんろ}→お遍路：19059_ohenro⟧さん. Pilgrims traditionally wear white and carry a staff that stands for Kōbō Daishi walking beside them.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧{八十八箇所|はちじゅうはっかしょ}: the Shikoku eighty-eight temples
- {八十八箇所|はちじゅうはっかしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧ / ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to make the circuit
- ⟦お{遍路|へんろ}→お遍路：19059_ohenro⟧さん: a pilgrim on the circuit
- {札所|ふだしょ}: one of the numbered temples of the circuit

WRITING:
Also written {八十八|はちじゅうはち}ヶ{所|しょ} or {八十八|はちじゅうはち}カ{所|しょ}, read the same way. Smaller copies of the circuit elsewhere in Japan borrow the name.
